flaps._comment: iniBuilds' published A350 interfaces and aircraft documentation identify the normal CONF 0 / 1 / 1+F / 2 / 3 / FULL sequence. Placard speeds are intentionally omitted from the executable profile.

lvars._comment: Only stable state/readback variables from iniBuilds' public A350 LVAR list are mapped. Auto-resetting FCU button variables remain excluded. The four numeric FCU windows use the documented direct set/read variables.

controls._comment: The trusted iniBuilds A350 adapter owns vendor-specific LVAR writes and requires newer logical readback. Standard SimConnect events are limited to gear, flaps, parking brake and spoilers with explicit state confirmation. Broad generic autopilot writes are disabled.

meta.notes: Shared trusted integration for the iniBuilds A350-900 and A350-1000. The dedicated aircraft page and voice catalogue use vendor-published stable A350 LVARs for FCU, EFIS, lighting, signs, APU, air and anti-ice controls, plus guarded standard surface controls.

sources.name: Original HubHop A350 ND range mappings
sources.notes: HubHop presets map INI_MAP_RANGE_CAPT_SWITCH and INI_MAP_RANGE_FO_SWITCH positions 5..11 to the normal 10..640 NM range detents. This differs from INI_MAP_MODE_RANGE_* in the official LVar PDF. The adapter uses the original integration spelling with same-field confirmation, never writes both names, and leaves airport zoom selection unavailable. A350 is not installed locally; live validation of names and ND mode-dependent displayed scale is required. See docs/ATC-EFIS-AIRCRAFT-COVERAGE.md.

sources.name: iniBuilds A350 Airliner LVAR List (A350 LVARs-FEB2025.pdf)
sources.notes: iniBuilds staff publish the stable INI_* variable names, types, selector detents and direct set/read FCU variables used by this adapter, and explicitly document third-party read/write use. APU START review 2026-09-06 reuses the vendor-published INI_APU_MASTER_SWITCH=1 and INI_APU_START_BUTTON=1 mappings. The shared preset confirms master ON then acknowledges the START write without waiting for the start-button readback or spool-up. The button state is not treated as AVAIL. No installed A350 build was available during this review.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 SDK aircraft events
sources.notes: Source for the bounded GEAR_UP, GEAR_DOWN, FLAPS_INCR, FLAPS_DECR, PARKING_BRAKE_SET, SPOILERS_ARM_OFF, SPOILERS_ARM_ON and SPOILERS_SET routes. Each route is guarded and confirmed through a newer standard SimVar readback.

sources.name: iniBuilds A350 Airliner for MSFS product page
sources.notes: Product and simulator-platform context for the shared A350 family profile.

knownIssues: All aircraft-specific writes are source-backed and readback-guarded, but remain marked untested until exercised against the current installed A350 package.
AP1, AP2, A/THR, LOC, APPR, FCU push/pull and relative selector command variables auto-reset. They remain excluded until a separate stable mode confirmation is available.
The public LVAR document's emergency-exit legend contains a duplicated value. The adapter interprets its declared 0-2 domain as OFF=0, ARM=1 and ON=2 pending live validation.
Standard surface events can still be ignored or incompletely mirrored by a custom aircraft; every surface action therefore requires newer matching logical readback and never retries.

Start APU UI and voice preset is source-backed and covered by automated transport tests; live start, electrical prerequisites, selector release and aircraft variant/build coverage remain untested. See docs/APU-START-VALIDATION.md.
